address: Concorde Club, Stoneham Lane, Eastleigh, Hampshire,SO50 9HQ
bio: The Concorde is rich with musical heritage; they hosted early performances from Rod Stewart, Eric Clapton, and Elton John. The restaurant captures this heritage with its picture-adorned walls.  Afternoon Tea is served either in The Fig restaurant, the woodland terrace or the riverside patio. Afternoon Tea consists of finger sandwiches, cake selection,sultana scones with clotted cream and strawberry preserve, and a choice of a selection of tea or coffee.
